newsitem.title: UK: Select Appointments see satisfactory full yr.
newsitem.headline: Select Appointments see satisfactory full yr.

text.p: British-based recruitment firm Select Appointments (Holdings) Plc, which posted a 70 percent jump in second quarter profits, said on Wednesday it expected a satisfactory outcome for the full year.

"The outlook for the staffing services industry remains very favourable as markets increasingly accept flexible work patterns and deregulation continues," chairman Tony Martin said in the results statement.
"With continuing strong internal growth I look forward to a satisfactory outcome for the year as a whole."
Pre-tax profits in the three months to June 30 increased to 7.3 million stg from 4.3 million in the comparable period a year ago.

For the half year, pre-tax profits were up 72 percent at 13.3 million stg on turnover of 241 million, up 50 percent. The firm proposed a 20 percent rise in the interim dividend to 1.2 pence per share.
